Fences · Dead Drops · A Shared Cant

Not a person and not a place — a decentralized network of fences, brokers, and dead-drop points operating in every Free Haven and gray zone in the wasteland, held together by a shared sigil system and a cant that changes just often enough to keep outsiders from learning it twice. Nobody runs the Underledger. Everybody in it just agrees to keep running it.

Mechanically: the source of Dead Drop Network, Underledger Favor, and Underledger Rank (§5). A Scavenger-Spy in good standing can find help almost anywhere the Underledger reaches — which, by now, is nearly everywhere.
